content:
maria: kicking off staged rollout r-20240305-41 -> canary 5% (EU) now. change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. tagging release in notes.
aj: ack. who’s oncall for infra this window?
samir: I’m oncall, watching the usual panels (grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abc).
deploy-bot: deploy r-20240305-41 started -> canary(5%) | commit c3f9a2 | model:v2.4.1-quant | routing-id: r-20240305-41-canary | jobs: router=on, kvcache=true
katie: quick heads-up — we pinned EU routing to v2.4.1-quant due to memory profile.
leo: request: do not drain old pool until we verify session handoff. overlapping sessions can cause double-kv writes.
maria: plan: pin + soft-drain. will start `kubectl drain nodepool-eu-legacy --ignore-daemonsets --grace-period=30s` in 10m unless we see regressions.
aj: if p99 latency > 200ms for > 5m or errors > 1% we hold and escalate.
samir: small bump at t+3m — p99=190ms, errors=0.22% (mostly timeouts from one host). watching.
deploy-bot: telemetry snapshot: canary_latency_p50=45ms, p95=120ms, p99=182ms, errors=0.18%, qps=120
maria: good. leaving a 10m observation. will call stop/go at :50 for ramp decision.
katie: if we stop, fallback plan is pin traffic back to v2.3.9 and trigger rollback playbook. runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/rollbacks#v2-rollback
ops-bot: note add -> "canary-eu-5pct" tags=[rollout, canary, eu] : added by ops-bot
ops-bot: incident created -> INC-20240305-21 (https://inc.redwood/INC-20240305-21)
samir: dashboards steady after the transient. p99 trending down to ~170ms.
aj: +1 on continuing observation.
maria: calling stop/go — waiting 45s for objections.
aj: no objections from infra, go for 20%.
katie: confirm we've prepared release notes snippet: "Pinned quantized model variant v2.4.1-quant for EU to mitigate memory pressure; staged rollout starting 5% -> 20%"
deploy-bot: applying routing change -> canary ramp to 20% (region: eu). routing rule id: r-20240305-41-canary-20.
maria: will start soft-drain in 5m (`kubectl drain nodepool-eu-legacy --timeout=10m`) after we verify stable warmup. call out if KV cache OOM or 502 spike.
samir: saw one 502 on host eu-12, restarted worker, host healthy now. no further 502s.
leo: noted — keeping an eye on mem pressure, but current RSS looks within margin on quant builds.
maria: consensus: proceed to 50% after 30m observation barring regressions. tagging this thread with outcome and adding to release notes. closing thread in 5m unless anyone reopens. :thumbsup:
